_comment: ZoomEye (api.zoomeye.ai v2) endpoint path templates + per-run budget for wp_zoomeye.py. The key travels in the API-KEY header on a POST whose JSON body carries a base64-encoded query (qbase64 = base64('iconhash="<mmh3>"')). Response success code is 60000. ZoomEye bills query quota; the caller gates it `and not free_only`. Overrides the inline _ZOOMEYE_FALLBACK; a missing/bad file degrades to that fallback with a warning.

endpoints._comment: v2 REST paths (joined to https://api.zoomeye.ai). search POSTs the base64 iconhash query and returns asset rows.

budget._comment: per-run guard rails; page_size caps how many rows one favicon reverse returns.
